english:
files="$RUNNER_TEMP/changed-files"
          : > "$files"
          if [ "$EVENT" = pull_request ]; then
            gh api --paginate "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/pulls/$PULL_REQUEST/files" --jq '.[].filename' > "$files"
          elif [[ "$BEFORE" =~ ^0*$ ]] || ! gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/compare/$BEFORE...$SHA" --jq '.files[].filename' > "$files" || [ "$(wc -l < "$files")" -ge 300 ]; then
            # A new branch, an unreachable base, or a list at the compare API's 300-file cap has no
            # complete file list, so the push runs full qualification.
            LABELS=full-ci
          fi
          node scripts/ci-changes.mjs "$files" "$LABELS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
